claims.summary: Scion owns the correct Gemma 4 turn format, produces coherent real-browser output, discloses first-use download progress, fails visibly, and avoids unnecessary cross-origin-isolation headers.

Both smoke adapters are explicitly non-promotable, and future promotion requires five unique hash-paired adapter/base courses on identical clean compiler, input, source, grader, base-weight, and scale contracts. The legacy artifact is base-mismatched, while the exact-QAT artifact uses smoke-only structural evidence and has no normal-scale quality proof. The product remains base-only until a real candidate passes every corpus, pairing, quality, efficiency, factual, device, export, and instructor gate.
